channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Inside the Dangote Family Vision and the Next Era of African Industry
item.description: What does the future hold for one of Africa's most powerful industrial empires? In this exclusive conversation on Bloomberg Next Africa, Halima, Mariya, and Fatima Dangote sit down to discuss the next generation of leadership at the Dangote Group — from expanding cement production and investing in refining, fertilizer and power to building a family office focused on preserving the family’s legacy for generations. They also discuss creating more value from Africa’s resources at home, the role of partnerships and investment, and plans for a pan-African IPO of the Dangote refinery. Discover how Aliko Dangote’s daughters plan to carry forward their father's legacy through strategic growth, diversification, and long-term wealth preservation. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Chinese Chipmaker CXMT Sues Pentagon to Get Off US Blacklist
item.description: CXMT Corp. filed a lawsuit against the US Department of Defense, seeking removal from a blacklist that identified the Chinese chipmaker as a supporter of the Communist country’s military.
item.dc:creator: Ville Heiskanen

item.title: OpenAI to End Partnership With Cursor After SpaceX Acquisition
item.description: OpenAI said it will end its partnership with Cursor after the AI-coding agent’s acquisition by SpaceX, according to a post on X.
item.dc:creator: Yi Wei Wong

item.title: Affirm CEO: American Consumers Are Healthy
item.description: Affirm CEO Max Levchin joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the company's recent earnings report, including an upbeat revenue outlook as the short-term loan company sees its most profitable quarter on record. Levchin also discusses recent partnerships, e-commerce growth, and the state of the consumer, saying Affirm customers are "healthy, paying us back on time, and shopping." He speaks with Tim Stenovec and Lisa Mateo. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: SentinelOne CEO on Earnings, AI's Cybersecurity Impact
item.description: SentinelOne co-founder, chairman and CEO Tomer Weingarten discusses earnings and AI Cybersecurity in an interview with Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Warsh Says Inflation Isn't Slowing | The Close 8/28/2026
item.description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are BMO US President Aron Levine, Morgan Stanley Investment Management Senior Portfolio Manager Andrew Slimmon, Cisco President & Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel, SentinelOne Co-Founder Tomer Weingarten, Oliver Wyman CEO Ted Moynihan, Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick, The Conference Board Chief Economist Dana Peterson, Former SEC Chair Mike Piwowar, and IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: BMO US President: See growth beyond AI plane
item.description: BMO US President Aron Levine says they are seeing their clients work through many different scenarios when it comes to the integration of AI, but that there are signs of growth across many different sectors. He also gives his reaction to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole Symposium. He speaks to Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Cisco President Patel Makes the Case for AI in the Classroom
item.description: Cisco President and Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel explains how artificial intelligence will benefit the education system on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: California Sues Over Trump Deal to Cancel Wind Project Lease
item.description: California sued the Trump administration and Golden State Wind over the federal government’s deal with the company to cancel an offshore wind project lease, alleging the transaction violated multiple federal laws.
item.dc:creator: Allison Prang

item.title: Jackson Hole, Anthropic’s Court Win and PayPal Deal Collapse | Bloomberg Tech 8/28/2026
item.description: Bloomberg’s Tim Stenovec zeroes in on Jackson Hole after Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh delivered his first address at the Symposium. Plus, a US judge rules that the Trump administration must lift its ban on Anthropic's AI tech for federal agencies. And, a consortium of Advent and Stripe decided to abandon its pursuit of PayPal, a deal that would have ranked as one of the biggest-ever leveraged buyouts. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rogoff Says Economic Shock Needed to Force US Deficit Reform
item.description: Kenneth Rogoff, professor of economics at Harvard University and former chief economist at the IMF, discusses the US deficit problem and why he thinks it is unlikely to be addressed until a major crisis forces voters to act. He speaks with Bloomberg's Tom Keene at the Federal Reserve’s annual conference in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Cyber Command to Brief Congress Military Committee on Suicides
item.description: US military officials are set to brief a House oversight committee next week as part of lawmakers’ examination of an unusually high number of deaths by suicide among personnel of the country’s cyberwarfare unit, according to a committee spokesperson.
item.dc:creator: Jake Bleiberg and Patrick Howell O'Neill

item.title: Nvidia-Backed Lambda Inks $1 Billion Private Debt for Chip Deal
item.description: Lambda Inc., an AI cloud-computing provider backed by Nvidia Corp., has raised about $1 billion of private short-dated debt for computing chips tied to its collaboration with Microsoft Corp.
item.dc:creator: Emily Graffeo

item.title: Quantum Firm Pasqal Shares Jump 95% in Debut Via SPAC Merger
item.description: Pasqal Holding SA soared in its first day of trading after the quantum computing company went public in New York via a merger with a blank-check firm, outperforming other quantum companies that have recently debuted.
item.dc:creator: Emily Forgash

item.title: Meta’s Newspaper Ad Blitz Ups Pressure on Social Media Rivals
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. is intensifying its public pressure campaign on TikTok and YouTube, running full-page advertisements in top newspapers across the US demanding its rivals make comparable efforts to strengthen social media protections for teens.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra S. Levine

item.title: Andreessen Horowitz Raises $1.1 Billion for AI Infrastructure Fund
item.description: Prominent venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz says it has raised $1.1 billion for its newest artificial intelligence infrastructure fund.
item.dc:creator: Micah Barkley and Natasha Mascarenhas

item.title: S&P 500 Falls on Tech Selloff as Warsh Vows to Fight Inflation
item.description: Stocks ended the day lower Friday after a hawkish Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speech, which led traders and strategists to increase bets on interest-rate hikes this year.
item.dc:creator: Geoffrey Morgan

item.title: Plaud Unveils Earbuds With 4G Connectivity in AI Gadgets Push
item.description: Plaud Inc., a startup that makes note-taking devices, announced a pair of wireless, 4G-connected earbuds that lets users record conversations and complete tasks with artificial-intelligence assistants on the go, adding to a nascent category of gadgets built for the AI era.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Lung

item.title: Samsung’s $700 Galaxy 26 FE Gets a Price Hike Even With Many Tradeoffs
item.description: Samsung Electronics Co. introduced the Galaxy S26 FE, its latest smartphone aimed at consumers who want a device that’s priced well below high-end models but still offers at least a few premium features.
item.dc:creator: Chris Welch

item.title: US Says China-Linked Hackers Targeted NASA and Fed
item.description: The US Justice Department said authorities disrupted online infrastructure allegedly used by Chinese state-sponsored hackers to target American government agencies and critical infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News
